notes: Card: 'st' x5, ' Infantry' x4, 'rd' x2, 'th' x2 of the top 32, all inside names such as '61st Australian Infantry Battalion', '303rd Squadron', '121st Fighter Squadron'. The opposite pole fires on ' the' before 'military / armed services', i.e. the armed forces in general versus one numbered unit. Probes: 101st Airborne Division 0.75, 42nd Fighter Squadron 0.45, 7th Cavalry Regiment 0.52; '42nd floor … 5th Avenue' 0.00, '101st episode' 0.03, soldiers without a unit 0.05. Near misses are ordinals outside the military and soldiers without a numbered unit.
